description: COMBINE two confirmed orthogonal wins both near 4,585us from different lineages: brief 18's faster FP32 panel (361bc7a0, 4,583us — coalesced HBM load, zero register spill, fused write-back/V-build on the n=512/1024/2048 panel) AND brief 20's n=4096 cooperative-cluster path (8ae528bc2, 4,595us — n=4096 B=2 31k via K=16 thread-block cluster, was 52k geqrf). Brief 18 still routes n=4096 to geqrf; brief 20 has the OLD slower panel for n<=2048. Stack both: brief 18's panel for n<=2048 + brief 20's _blocked_qr_cluster for n=4096. The two diffs touch disjoint code (panel kernel vs the n=4096 routing branch) so they compose cleanly. Re-measure min-of-3 (bimodal). Avoid the substring 'stream' anywhere incl. comments.

COMBINE parent A's FAST FP32 panel (n<=2048, brief-18/361bc7a0) + parent B's n=4096 cooperative-cluster panel (brief-13/20/8ae528bc2). Took parent A as base; grafted parent B's disjoint n=4096 path: _SUPPORTED_N+={4096}, _CLUSTER_N={4096}, ported panel_factor_cluster_kernel (sm_100a cluster K=16, DSMEM map_shared_rank, WCH=8 no-spill chunks) + launcher + _blocked_qr_cluster (hybrid cluster m>=mhyb=256 / single-CTA short panels / whole-batch TF32 trailing); route n=4096 -> cluster not geqrf. Parent A panel_factor_kernel body BYTE-IDENTICAL; n<=2048/tiny-n/n=352 EXACTLY parent A. geomean min-of-3 4394.12us (4394.12/4395.27/4395.70, stable not bimodal) = 1.043x over parent A (4582.884), 1.046x over parent B (4595.23). n=4096 B=2 shape ~31360us (cluster) vs ~52k geqrf. nsys n=4096: panel_factor_cluster_kernel 66.7%, TF32 trailing GEMMs ~27%, single-CTA short panels 2.3%. All 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN.

COMBINE LANDED, HEAD=250a694cd. Stacked the two confirmed orthogonal wins exactly as briefed: took parent A (361bc7a0, 4582.884us global best) as base and grafted parent B's (8ae528bc2) n=4096 cooperative-cluster path onto it. The diffs were genuinely disjoint -- parent A's panel_factor_kernel body is BYTE-IDENTICAL in the result (no panel reversions; verified the diff vs parent A touches ZERO panel-internal lines), and the n<=2048 / tiny-n / n=352 routing is EXACTLY parent A. The graft is purely additive: cooperative_groups include, MAXWARPS define, panel_factor_cluster_kernel (sm_100a thread-block cluster K=16, DSMEM cross-CTA reductions via cluster.map_shared_rank, WCH=8 no-spill dot chunks, fused col-norm cutting cluster.sync 4->3/col) + its launcher, _blocked_qr_cluster (hybrid: cluster panel for m>=mhyb=256, single-CTA panel for short trailing panels, whole-batch TF32 trailing), _CLUSTER_N={4096}, +4096 to _SUPPORTED_N, n=4096 _nb_for=16, and the 'if n in _CLUSTER_N' routing branch placed BEFORE 'if n>=2048' so 4096 hits the cluster (not the single-CTA TF32 path). Kept parent B's cluster config (K=16/threads=256/cb=16/mhyb=256) unchanged.

RESULT: geomean min-of-4 4394.12us (runs 4394.12/4395.27/4395.70/4400.16, very tight, NOT bimodal -- no 2x-slow run across 4) = 1.043x over parent A (4582.884), 1.046x over parent B (4595.23). The win is exactly the predicted mechanism: n<=2048 shapes land at parent A's level (n=512 ~7843us, n=1024 ~9046us, n=2048 ~16910us, all unchanged from parent A) while n=4096 B=2 dropped from ~52k geqrf to ~31360us via the cluster -- and since the geomean weights all 12 shapes equally (1/12), that one shape's 1.66x is the entire geomean drop. All 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN (n=4096 cond=1/upper both pass on the cluster path; n=2048 dense/rankdef/mixed pass on parent A's single-CTA panel; diff_correctness runs the n=4096 B=2 bench shape and passes).

nsys n=4096: panel_factor_cluster_kernel is 66.7pct (39.4ms/482 launches), TF32 trailing GEMMs ~27pct (cutlass3x_sm100 tensorop), single-CTA short trailing panels only 2.3pct -- so the cluster panel itself is the n=4096 bottleneck (matches parent B's finding that at K=16/B=2 it is latency/sync-bound).

STILL OPEN under this combine's objective (directions I did NOT pursue because the brief fenced the cluster config + the n<=2048 panel as fixed -- for the manager to weigh as fresh briefs): (a) the n=4096 cluster panel is 66.7pct of that shape and sync-bound -- parent B noted achieved occupancy ~6.25pct at K=16/B=2 (only 2*16=32 CTAs on 148 SMs); a deeper restructure (more rows/CTA at smaller K to raise warps-per-scheduler, or pipelining the per-column cluster.sync chain) could cut the 31360us further but was out of scope here. (b) The n=4096 trailing GEMM is whole-batch TF32; cb sweep was parent B's (16 optimum) but a 2-level micro-panel inside the cluster kernel (parity with parent A's IB=8 single-CTA panel, which the cluster kernel does NOT have -- it is single-level unblocked over cb columns) was never tried for the cluster. (c) parent A's own open direction (brief-18 stop) -- the n=512 single-CTA panel is occupancy-bound at ~11-13pct / 2 blocks/SM capped by the 64KB SMEM P; a split-P or tail-streamed panel fitting >2 blocks/SM would lift the dominant n=512 group and is fully orthogonal to this n=4096 work. (d) mhyb/K co-tuning for n=4096 was held at parent B's values per the brief; a joint sweep is untried on top of parent A's faster base.
